mapper.select: SELECT CUC_CERTDN FROM atsprd.ATS_CPR_USER_CERT WHERE CUC_ECIFNO =#{ecino} AND CUC_USERNO =#{userno} AND CUC_CERTSTATE = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE atsprd.ATS_CPR_USER_CERT SET CUC_CERTDN =#{certdn},CUC_USBKEYSN =#{usbkey} WHERE CUC_ECIFNO =#{ecino} AND CUC_USERNO =#{userno} AND CUC_CERTSTATE = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT t.ASM_CODE,t.ASM_CREATETIME from (SELECT * FROM atsprd.ATS_SENDDYNAMIC_MSG WHERE ASM_MOBILENO =#{mobilePhone} ORDER BY ASM_FLOWNO DESC) t WHERE ROWNUM = 1
